title: Company Sales Analysis
subtitle: Power BI · Business intelligence
summary: A Power BI dashboard project exploring company sales performance across business categories and presenting trends in a visual reporting format.
evidence: The repository describes company sales analysis and hospital/pharmacy analysis. I have not found a separate public repository or evidence for a predictive machine-learning model, so this card is deliberately described as sales analysis rather than forecasting.

title: Jumia Product Performance Dashboard
subtitle: Excel · E-commerce analytics
summary: An interactive Excel dashboard exploring Jumia product pricing, discounts, ratings, and customer reviews to understand product performance and customer engagement.
evidence: The project cleans product and price fields, engineers discount and rating categories, and explores relationships between discounts, ratings, and reviews. The repository reports a weak relationship between higher discounts and engagement, while higher-rated products tend to attract more reviews.

title: East Africa Travel & Hotel RAG Advisor
subtitle: Python · Semantic search · Streamlit
summary: An accommodation discovery tool combining web scraping, data cleaning, geographic enrichment, semantic retrieval, and an interactive interface for exploring stays across East Africa.
evidence: The repository documents a pipeline from 109 initially collected accommodation records to 99 cleaned records, followed by geographic enrichment, embeddings, ChromaDB indexing, a FastAPI retrieval service, and a Streamlit UI with filters and map visualization. The README notes that a fully generative RAG workflow would additionally require passing retrieved context to a language model.

title: Digital Surveillance & Technology Governance in Kenya
subtitle: Undergraduate research · International relations
summary: Academic research examining the implications of US–China rivalry for digital surveillance, digital sovereignty, and technological autonomy in Kenya between 2013 and 2025.
evidence: The research draws on Realism, Dependency Theory, and World-Systems Theory. The final public description distinguishes the methods proposed in the research design from methods actually completed, and should only state findings supported by the final report.

title: Ministry of Foreign and Diaspora Affairs
subtitle: Administrative & Research Intern · May–August 2024
summary: Experience in the Asia and Pacific Directorate supporting geopolitical and policy research, briefing notes, official documentation, records management, and departmental coordination.
evidence: Responsibilities included preparing reports and meeting documentation, supporting administrative operations, coordinating meeting logistics, and handling confidential information professionally. Do not publish internal or confidential government documents.
